intro: You're an ordinary student living an ordinary life.
You take the bus home and you fall asleep because of how tired you are.
When you wake up, you suddenly find yourself in a forest.
A forest full of other worldly creatures and unique plants and trees never seen on Earth.
This shocks you yet you get up because you have a feeling that something in this land is calling upon you.
Once you get up, your journey in this new world begins!
